patch_description: The expensive simulated annealing keeps stalling at 0.02 while consuming most of the 9s budget. Replace it with a smooth-minimum (log-sum-exp) Adam gradient ascent on all 165 triangle areas simultaneously: the softmin relaxation gives gradient signal to *every* bottleneck triplet at once, which random single-point perturbation lacks. Adam re-homogenizes the area distribution, then the existing `_polish` sharpens it. Wrap this in a cheap outer loop (Adam → polish → reheat Adam → polish, keeping the best), per the recommendation. This directly attacks the 0.02 plateau with gradient information instead of blind search.
